provider: nextfiles.one (managed Nextcloud CE and Seafile Pro)
category: managed Nextcloud and Seafile, paid only

free_tier.stated: No free tier. A one-month free trial on the Nextcloud CE plans. Nextcloud CE: Premium Silver 1 TB at EUR 4.99/month, Premium Gold 3 TB at EUR 14.99, Premium Platinum 5 TB at EUR 39.99, Premium Max 10 TB at EUR 99.99. Seafile Pro from EUR 9.90/month for 500 GB

per_object_cap.stated: Not published as a per-file cap on the private-customer plans. The plan table publishes storage, a recommended user count and the storage type ('Cluster')

retention.stated: Contract term from one month with automatic renewal for the same period; a consumer may cancel any time before a new billing period. Disaster-recovery backups of the last 7 days are kept, with managed or own backups offered for up to 10 years

egress.terms: No egress price and no traffic quota are published on the private-customer plans, so this field is false by the schema's own definition rather than on a stated guarantee. The features block says 'Unlimited storage space in the Cloud', which is about capacity and not about traffic

tooling: rclone webdav against any Nextcloud CE plan; the Nextcloud clients; administrator access to the AppStore. The Seafile Pro plans need the Seafile client or the Seafile WebDAV extension, which is a weaker tooling story
chaining: The only reseller in this slot that also offers Seafile, which matters when library-level end-to-end encryption is wanted. It does not scale: the per-terabyte rate is best on the smallest tier and worst on the largest, so it is a small-instance option rather than an archive target

limits.value: not published on the private-customer plans

identity_cost.detail: a nextfiles.one account and a card. The trial needs no card, per the plan text, and the paid order does. No identity document stated

reliability_note: Germany, ISO 27001 data centres, renewable power. The per-terabyte price rises with size, which is the opposite of every other reseller here and is the signal that the large tiers are not built for price comparison

price_per_tb_month: EUR 4.99/TB/month at 1 TB rising to EUR 10.00/TB/month at 10 TB, including VAT, read 2026-10-22
binding_note: The price curve decides the tier and the tier is small, so the unstated per-file cap is the number a buyer cannot plan around. At EUR 10/TB/month on the 10 TB plan it is also four times Serverdiscounter, which is why it is recorded as a small-instance option.
